hooks.description: Block any file containing an API key, token, or secret from being written or committed.
hooks.name: no-secrets
hooks.rule: No file may contain an API key, token, password, or secret of any kind.

hooks.description: Implementation must follow the spec in .kiro/specs/clippy-reborn/; design changes update the spec first.
hooks.name: spec-before-code
hooks.rule: Draft or update the spec before writing implementation code.

hooks.description: The .kiro directory must never be gitignored; Kiroween disqualifies repos without it at the root.
hooks.name: kiro-must-not-be-gitignored
hooks.rule: .gitignore must not contain a rule that ignores .kiro.
